brief_text: I need to accelerate securing funding within the next 2 months. We've been focused on investment firms that do deals between £1-2 million, mostly based in the UK. We'll keep sending cold emails and trying to find warm connections, but I want to explore alternatives to support the funding process, as we'll run out of money soon. For example, angel investors might be able to provide a small amount of funding quicker to buy us more time, but we would need to decide whether the overhead would be worth it.
